newsitem.title: ITALY: Customs brokers to meet in Manila, October 13-17.
newsitem.headline: Customs brokers to meet in Manila, October 13-17.

text.p: The Italian National Council of Customs Brokers said it will take part in the 1996 biennal International Federation of Customs Brokers Associations' World conference in Manila.

The Chamber of Customs Brokers, Inc. and the Federation of Air Cargo Forwarders and Brokers of the Philippines will jointly host the conference on 13-17 October at the Westin Philippine Plaza hotel, it added.

The conference will cover industry devlopments including the relevance of customs brokers under GATT/WTO; a common approach to the valuation of international goods as well as the simplification and harmonisation of customs procedures and practices. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
